Name: Better Dog Bark
Author: vcsama
Description:
[size=5][b]更好的大狗叫[/b][/size]

让你的狗用“叫叫叫”和蓄力“大狗……叫——”战斗。考取驾照后骑狗下矿，完成公会委托，收集三种声波项圈。

使用你已经养的狗，保留原来的名字、品种和外观。支持简体中文与英文，梗语音保留中文。

[size=4][b]从一只叮咚鸡开始[/b][/size]

在玛妮的商店购买一只叮咚鸡，手持它左键点击你的狗，确认喂食，即可解锁跟随和自动攻击。不需要每天喂食。

带狗到冒险者公会，在壁炉旁的原版怪物目标板登记，依次完成驾驶、声波和矿道三场考试，取得属于你的大狗驾照。考试场内可以临时骑乘，通过全部考试后解锁日常骑乘和骑乘战斗。同一玩家换狗不用重考，每只新狗仍需喂一次叮咚鸡。

[size=4][b]骑狗与战斗[/b][/size]

轻点左键，发出连贯的“叫叫叫”；长按蓄力，伴随逐渐升调的“大狗”，松手接长长的“叫——”和贯穿声波。

约2.8秒达到满蓄力。满蓄后可以继续按住，等到合适的时机再释放。骑乘时还可以冲刺，蓄力中也能冲刺和转向。

默认按键：
[list]
[*]K：打开大狗菜单。[/*]
[*]R：上下狗；拿证后也可以右键点击未骑乘的出战狗上狗。[/*]
[*]左键：轻点普攻，长按蓄力，松开释放。[/*]
[*]左 Shift：冲刺。[/*]
[/list]在原版菜单的动物栏点击狗，也可以召回、让它休息或打开装备页。

[size=4][b]公会委托与项圈[/b][/size]

拿证后可以在公会公告板接取三个委托：守护玛妮的鸡舍、护送克林特的矿车，以及探索矿道回声。接取后带出战狗到达对应地图，满足条件便会自动开始。

完成委托可获得三种项圈：
[list]
[*]长鸣：更远、更窄的贯穿声波。[/*]
[*]震荡：前方扇形攻击与更强的击退。[/*]
[*]回声：主声波撞墙后向两侧分叉。[/*]
[/list]项圈是背包中的实物。在动物栏点击狗，将项圈放进装备槽即可，一只狗同时戴一条。

驾照可以挂在农舍墙上，展示狗的照片和考试记录，右键查看详情。

[size=4][b]大狗“浇”音效[/b][/size]

升级水壶蓄力时也能听到“大狗……叫——”。声音随原版蓄力档位变化，每种水壶的最后一声“大狗”都是同一个最高音，不改变浇水范围、体力消耗和蓄力时间。

默认开启，可在GMCM或配置文件中关闭。

[size=4][b]安装与设置[/b][/size]

[list]
[*]安装[url=https://smapi.io/]SMAPI[/url]。[/*]
[*]解压下载的压缩包，将BetterDogJiao文件夹放进游戏的Mods文件夹。[/*]
[*]通过SMAPI启动游戏。[/*]
[/list]发布验证环境：Windows、Stardew Valley 1.6.15、SMAPI 4.5.2。

推荐安装[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5098]Generic Mod Config Menu（GMCM）[/url]，并非必需。可以调整按键、语音音量，以及大狗“浇”音效开关。

[size=4][b]宠物模组兼容[/b][/size]

已分别配对验证：
[list]
[*][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/24026]Pets Enhanced[/url]：26.0.5。[/*]
[*][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/50402]Fellowship of the Pets（FOTP）[/url]：3.4.23，资源包3.4.21。[/*]
[*][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/40711]Active and Useful Pets[/url]：1.3.1。[/*]
[/list]出战狗的战斗、跟随、骑乘及转场由本模组负责；外部等级、装备和背包数据保留，其他宠物继续使用外部玩法。外部背包从原模组自己的界面打开。出战期间，外部帽子及表情叠加暂时隐藏。

骑乘坐姿根据狗的贴图轮廓识别，开发期间已测试Elle's Dog Replacements 1.1.1和Elle's Cuter Dogs 1.0.2。自定义绘制框架及非标准动画布局尚未验证。

[size=4][b]联机[/b][/size]

已实现联机同步及房主结算，所有玩家需安装相同版本。驾照进度按玩家分别记录，同一玩家的狗共用驾照。

[size=5][b]Better Dog Bark[/b][/size]

Give your dog meme-powered bark attacks, earn a riding license, and take on guild jobs for three charged-bark collars.

Uses your existing dog, keeping its name, breed and appearance. English and Simplified Chinese text are included. Meme voice clips remain in Chinese.

[size=4][b]Start with a Ding-Dong Chicken[/b][/size]

Buy a Ding-Dong Chicken at Marnie's shop. Select it in your hotbar, left-click your dog and confirm to unlock following and automatic bark attacks. Daily feeding is not required.

Bring your dog to the Adventurer's Guild and register at the existing monster-goal board beside the fireplace. Complete the handling, bark control and mine tests to earn your dog riding license. Riding is temporarily available inside exam rooms; passing all three unlocks everyday riding and mounted combat. Your additional dogs share your license, but each needs its own Ding-Dong Chicken to unlock.

[size=4][b]Ride, charge and bark[/b][/size]

Tap left-click for a normal bark accompanied by three quick “jiao” calls. Hold to charge through a rising-pitch “da gou” chant, then release for a long “jiao” and a piercing sound wave.

Full charge takes about 2.8 seconds. You can keep holding at full charge and choose when to release. Dash while charging, change direction, and line up your shot.

Default controls:
[list]
[*]K: Open the dog menu.[/*]
[*]R: Mount or dismount. Once licensed, you can also right-click your unmounted active dog to mount.[/*]
[*]Left-click: Tap for a normal attack; hold and release for a charged bark.[/*]
[*]Left Shift: Dash.[/*]
[/list]Click your dog in the game's Animals tab to recall it, let it rest or open its equipment page.

[size=4][b]Guild jobs and collars[/b][/size]

After earning your license, accept three guild jobs: guard Marnie's chicken coop, escort Clint's minecart, and explore echoes in the mine. Bring your active dog to the destination after accepting a job; it starts automatically when its conditions are met.

Earn three collars that change your charged attack:
[list]
[*]Longcall: A longer, narrower piercing wave.[/*]
[*]Shockwave: A frontal fan-shaped attack with stronger knockback.[/*]
[*]Echo: A main wave that splits sideways when it hits a wall.[/*]
[/list]Collars are physical inventory items. Click your dog in the Animals tab and place a collar in its equipment slot. A dog wears one collar at a time.

Hang your license on a farmhouse wall to display your dog's portrait and exam records. Right-click it to view the details.

[size=4][b]Watering-can voice effect[/b][/size]

Upgraded watering cans can also play the “da gou… jiao” chant. The voice follows the game's charge stages, with every can's sequence ending on the same highest-pitched “da gou.” Watering range, stamina cost and charge timing keep their vanilla behavior.

Enabled by default. You can turn it off through GMCM or the configuration file.

[size=4][b]Installation and settings[/b][/size]

[list]
[*]Install [url=https://smapi.io/]SMAPI[/url].[/*]
[*]Extract the downloaded archive and place the BetterDogJiao folder in your game's Mods folder.[/*]
[*]Launch the game through SMAPI.[/*]
[/list]Release checks used Windows, Stardew Valley 1.6.15 and SMAPI 4.5.2.

[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5098]Generic Mod Config Menu[/url] is recommended, not required. It provides key bindings, voice volume and the watering-can sound toggle.

[size=4][b]Pet mod compatibility[/b][/size]

Checked individually with:
[list]
[*][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/24026]Pets Enhanced[/url]: 26.0.5.[/*]
[*][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/50402]Fellowship of the Pets (FOTP)[/url]: 3.4.23, with assets 3.4.21.[/*]
[*][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/40711]Active and Useful Pets[/url]: 1.3.1.[/*]
[/list]Better Dog Bark controls the active dog's combat, following, riding and travel. External progression, equipment and inventory data are retained. Other pets keep their external behavior. Use the external mod's own interface for its backpack. External hat and emote overlays are temporarily hidden on the active dog.

Riding positions use the dog's sprite silhouette. Elle's Dog Replacements 1.1.1 and Elle's Cuter Dogs 1.0.2 were checked during development. Custom rendering frameworks and nonstandard animation layouts are untested.

[size=4][b]Multiplayer[/b][/size]

Multiplayer synchronization and host-authoritative combat are implemented. All players need the same version. License progress is personal, and each player's dogs share that player's license.
